task_completion.description: Agent executes the script within GMAT to converge on the target parameters.

task_completion.visual_evidence: A file browser or terminal showing the script file exists at the specified path.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the final results file with the required labels and achieved values.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing ~/GMAT_output/tcm4_targeting_results.txt with lines for Achieved_RadPer_km, Achieved_INC_deg, and Total_Required_DeltaV_mps.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply calculate Delta-V manually but used the DifferentialCorrector tool.
integrity.visual_evidence: GMAT script or GUI panels showing 'Vary' and 'Achieve' commands being configured.

integrity.description: The values in the final report match the output generated by the GMAT run.
integrity.visual_evidence: Comparison between the GMAT message window/output reports and the final .txt file content.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must target a Radius of Periapsis (RadPer) of 6418.14 km and an Inclination (INC) of 45.0 deg. The propagation must stop at an altitude of 120.0 km. The initial state must be pulled from /home/ga/Desktop/stardust2_tcm_spec.txt. The final report must be at /home/ga/GMAT_output/tcm4_targeting_results.txt and contain exactly the three specified labels.
